title: Home Buying & Property Hour-of-Day Activity Heatmap
dataSources: Mortgage-rate snapshots (`mortgage:rate`), property-listing and Zestimate data (`property:listing`), HOA fees (`hoa:fee`), property-tax installments (`propertytax:installment`), home-buying milestones (`homebuying:milestone`).
app: Mortgage-rate watchers, Zestimate exports, HOA-fee logs, and property-tax installment trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and personal checklists.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mortgage:rate
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day most home buying events typically arrive.
value: Hour-of-day patterns expose automation schedules, commute windows, and habits that are easy to miss in daily totals alone.
implementation: Ingest `mortgage:rate` with accurate `_time` values and chart hourly counts to see when the feed is naturally busy or quiet.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of event count by hour of day.
grandmaExplanation: It notices what time of day your home buying data is usually busiest so you can spot routines that moved or feeds that went quiet at the wrong hour.
